kjv: when Pharaoh would hardly let us go
mine: when Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go
note: hiqshah par'oh leshallehenu means Pharaoh "made it hard" (was obstinate) about releasing them; modern "hardly" (= barely) almost reverses the sense.

mine: The people might change their minds
note: yinnahem (niphal of naham) here means to change one's mind or regret, not moral repentance.
hamushim is rare; probably "armed / in battle formation" (some connect it with "five", i.e. in ranks). "Harnessed" (= in armour) is now opaque.

kjv: He (Yahweh) took not away the pillar
note: lo yamish is intransitive ("did not move away"), with the pillar as subject; the KJV makes God the subject.
